## What this release does

`0.1.1` is the first working release — `0.1.0` loaded but silently did nothing. If you installed `0.1.0`, upgrade.

## The problem this plugin works around

Anthropic re-validates the signature of every `thinking` block on each request. When a reasoning turn is redacted for safety, it carries a short "lightweight" signature that does not pass re-validation on replay. Because the full message history is resent on every turn, a single such turn permanently breaks the whole session:

```
400 messages.N.content.M: Invalid `signature` in `thinking` block
```

## What the plugin does

On the `experimental.chat.messages.transform` hook, before the request reaches Anthropic, it removes `reasoning` parts from any assistant turn that contains a `redacted_thinking` block or a signed `thinking` block whose signature is shorter than `shortSignatureThreshold` (default `256`). Healthy signed reasoning and all text/tool content are left untouched, so the prompt-cache prefix is disturbed as little as possible.

## Fixed in 0.1.1

- The hook cloned the messages and reassigned `output.messages`. OpenCode keeps using its own array reference after the hook returns, so the reassignment was silently discarded and nothing was ever stripped (and `structuredClone` could throw on non-cloneable parts, swallowed by the fail-open guard). The hook now splices `reasoning` parts out of the original `message.parts` arrays **in place**, matching the mutation contract every other transform plugin relies on.

## Tests

- `test-hook.ts` — regression test for the in-place contract: fails if the hook reassigns the array or replaces message objects instead of mutating in place; asserts poisoned reasoning is removed and healthy reasoning survives.
- `test-fixture.ts` — strip-logic unit test over a fixture with redacted + short-signature turns.

## Verification

Reproduced end to end on a real failing session: with the plugin disabled the (forked) session still returns `Bad Request`; with it enabled the poisoned turns are stripped and the request succeeds.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/isac322/opencode-thinking-signature-guard/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

Initial release.

Strips non-replayable Anthropic reasoning blocks (redacted_thinking and short lightweight signatures) from poisoned assistant turns before OpenCode serializes the request, so replayed sessions stop returning `400 messages.N.content.M: Invalid \`signature\` in \`thinking\` block`. Healthy signed reasoning is left untouched.

- Hook: `experimental.chat.messages.transform`
- Zero-config (default mode: `redacted`), fail-open
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-thinking-signature-guard
